facts.business: Mahalaxmi Fabric Mills Limited is engaged in manufacturing and marketing of traditional textiles, including bleaching, dyeing, printing, and finishing of cotton, polyester, bottom-weight, and blended fabrics for domestic and global markets.
key_risks: Significant increase in cost of raw materials, power, fuel, and logistics
Major fire at factory premises causing extensive damage to assets and temporary production disruption
Technological obsolescence in spinning and processing segments leading to higher production costs
Rapidly evolving consumer preferences and intensified global competition
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the notes to the Standalone Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards. The company has provided guarantee to its subsidiary with outstanding balance of Rs. 3750 lakhs as at balance sheet date.
